leads.title: Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with Large Language Models
leads.summary: Compares encoder-only (FinBERT) vs encoder-decoder (BART) architectures for PEAD prediction using 8-K earnings filings; shows FinBERT captures narrative signals effectively with domain pretraining.
leads.implementation_note: H163/H174 extension: Replace ProsusAI/FinBERT with BART encoder-decoder for improved drift magnitude detection; test 3-day early signal gate for entry timing.

leads.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
leads.summary: Analyzes structural patterns in press release language to predict post-earnings returns; linguistic features beyond sentiment capture incremental PEAD signal.
leads.implementation_note: H163/H174 extension: Add press release structure extraction module to detect surprise framing and conviction signals beyond raw FinBERT score.

leads.title: Generating Alpha: Hybrid AI Trading System with FinBERT + Regime Classification
leads.summary: FinBERT sentiment filtering combined with HMM-based regime classification for regime-aware entry; tested Jan 2023–Jan 2025.
leads.implementation_note: H163/H174 variant: Add HMM regime gate on VIX + earnings volume to only take PEAD trades in favorable regimes.

leads.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization with Bias Correction
leads.summary: XGBoost (1000-3000 estimators) and LightGBM with Bayesian hyperparameter optimization for cross-sectional factor selection; outperforms CSI300 benchmark.
leads.implementation_note: H167 implementation template: Use GOSS+EFB LightGBM on rolling 252-day windows; start with Bayesian HPO config from this paper.

leads.title: Spatio-Temporal Momentum: Jointly Learning Time-Series and Cross-Sectional Strategies
leads.summary: Unified framework learning both time-series and cross-sectional momentum simultaneously; captures momentum spillovers across assets within sectors/size cohorts.
leads.implementation_note: H167 enhancement: Add spatio-temporal component for momentum lead-lag across sectors.

leads.title: Follow the Leader: Network Momentum for Trend-Following
leads.summary: Network momentum exploiting lead-lag in trend-following; combines univariate trend indicators with cross-sectional spillover via graph detection.
leads.implementation_note: H167 extension: Build sector correlation network; weight momentum signals by network centrality.

leads.title: PolySwarm: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Prediction Market Trading and Latency Arbitrage
leads.summary: 50-persona LLM swarm with confidence-weighted Bayesian aggregation for binary prediction markets; KL/JS divergence for cross-market inefficiency detection; quarter-Kelly sizing; demonstrates latency arbitrage on Polymarket/Kalshi.
leads.implementation_note: H185 implementation: Deploy PolySwarm framework for earnings binary predictions on Kalshi; confidence-weighted ensemble for pre-earnings nowcasting with 6-hour prediction window.

leads.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
leads.summary: LangGraph-based multi-agent framework with specialized analyst agents + trader + risk team; dynamic agent discussions; v0.2.0 supports GPT-5, Gemini 3, Claude 4, Grok 4 (Feb 2026).
leads.implementation_note: H185 extension: Integrate TradingAgents with earnings event focus; track historical accuracy per agent type for dynamic weighting.

leads.title: LLM Forecasting Review: Ensemble Methods and Multi-Modal Fusion (IEEE AI 2026)
leads.summary: Reviews LLM forecasting approaches; highlights ensemble decorrelation, sentiment-to-regime-probability mapping, and multi-modal fusion of market data with LLM signals.
leads.implementation_note: H185 variant: Map FinBERT sentiment to regime probabilities using LLM few-shot; fuse with market data for improved Kalshi nowcasting.

leads.title: Attention Factors for Statistical Arbitrage
leads.summary: Attention-based factor learning for stat arb achieves Sharpe 2.3 with transaction costs; 84% improvement over prior deep learning stat arb methods; daily frequency.
leads.implementation_note: New hypothesis candidate (H187?): Implement attention-based factor extraction on daily OHLCV for the 30-stock PEAD universe; z-score threshold entry; half-Kelly sizing with 5bps cost model.

leads.title: Statistical Arbitrage via LSTM Factor Replication (Polish Equities)
leads.summary: Replaces cointegration with PCA/ETF/LSTM factor models for pairs selection; achieves positive returns with lower transaction costs than traditional pairs.
leads.implementation_note: Daily pairs: LSTM factor replication on liquid large-cap pairs; test on Russell 3000 universe.

leads.title: Statistical Arbitrage in Options Markets by Graph Learning and Synthetic Long Positions
leads.summary: Graph learning for options-equity basis stat arb; synthetic bond method to isolate pure arbitrages.
leads.implementation_note: Combine with H186 (options flow); graph learning for option-equity basis arb pre-earnings.

leads.title: Generative AI for Stock Selection (SpiderRock Options Flow)
leads.summary: Uses SpiderRock options dataset (Put/Call ratios, IV surfaces, risk-neutral metrics) with generative AI to predict earnings surprises; Feb 2026.
leads.implementation_note: H186 implementation: Integrate SpiderRock options flow API; use generative model mapping Put/Call + Greeks to earnings surprise prediction; 30-60 min pre-earnings forecast window.

leads.title: Corporate Earnings Calls and Analyst Beliefs (arXiv:2511.15214)
leads.summary: Earnings call textual information markedly improves prediction of analyst expectations and forecast dispersion.
leads.implementation_note: H186 enhancement: Weight options flow signals by analyst surprise prediction from transcript FinBERT.

leads.title: Stock Prediction via Node Transformer with Options Flow (Put/Call, Gamma Exposure)
leads.summary: Node transformer reduces prediction error 10% overall, 25% during earnings using inter-stock relationships and options flow indicators.
leads.implementation_note: H186 variant: Node transformer modeling sector-level put/call flow patterns for earnings surprise direction.

leads.title: News Sentiment and Stock Market Dynamics: A Machine Learning Investigation
leads.summary: Sentiment alpha decays rapidly in recent years; implements monitoring for signal decay, retraining cycles, and audit logs for model governance.
leads.implementation_note: H163/H174 risk management: Add signal decay monitoring and 30-day retraining cycle; track rolling Sharpe per stock cohort.

leads.title: Wisdom of the Silicon Crowd: LLM Ensemble Prediction Rivals Human Crowd Accuracy
leads.summary: 12-LLM ensemble matches human crowd forecasting; ensemble decorrelation and fine-tuning improves robustness vs single-model reliance.
leads.implementation_note: H174 robustness: Replace single FinBERT with 5-7 LLM ensemble for PEAD scoring to reduce model-specific alpha decay.
